@Roth.min_le_sum_max : ∀ {θ : ℝ} {rp : ℕ} (l : ℕ),
  min (↑l * θ / 2) (↑rp * θ ^ 2 / 3) ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ↑ν / ↑rp)

theorem Roth.min_le_sum_max : ∀ {θ : ℝ} {rp : ℕ} (l : ℕ),
  min (↑l * θ / 2) (↑rp * θ ^ 2 / 3) ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ↑ν / ↑rp) :=
fun {θ} {rp} l ↦
  if hθ : θ ≤ 0 then
    LE.le.trans (min_le_left (↑l * θ / 2) (↑rp * θ ^ 2 / 3))
      (LE.le.trans
        (div_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (Nat.cast_nonneg l) hθ)
          (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_le_true (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ Nat.cast_zero)
            (Mathlib.Meta.NormNum.isNat_ofNat ℝ (Eq.refl 2)) (Eq.refl true)))
        (Finset.sum_nonneg fun x x_1 ↦ le_max_left 0 (θ - ↑x / ↑rp)))
  else
    Or.casesOn (le_or_gt (↑l) (θ * ↑rp))
      (fun hl ↦ LE.le.trans (min_le_left (↑l * θ / 2) (↑rp * θ ^ 2 / 3)) (Roth.mul_div_two_le_sum_max_aux✝ hl)) fun hl ↦
      LE.le.trans (min_le_right (↑l * θ / 2) (↑rp * θ ^ 2 / 3))
        (Roth.mul_sq_div_three_le_sum_max_aux✝ (le_of_not_ge hθ) (LT.lt.le hl))

MINSUM206_FULL_TYPE: ∀ {θ : ℝ} {rp : ℕ} (l : ℕ),
  min (↑l * θ / 2) (↑rp * θ ^ 2 / 3) ≤ ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (θ - ↑ν / ↑rp)
